elements.label: Figure 9.6
elements.title: Example of Heatmap Showing Differences from Average Temperature for January 2024 by Colors

details.legend/series: Color gradient from blue to red
details.color meaning: Blue represents a reduction in temperature, red represents an increase in temperature
details.values: Temperature differences shown spatially across the US map with blue areas mainly in central and western US indicating temperature reductions, and red areas mainly in northeastern US indicating temperature increases

elements.summary: This spatial heatmap visualizes the differences in average temperature for January 2024 compared to the 1991–2020 average, using a color gradient where blue indicates cooler than average and red indicates warmer than average temperatures across the United States.
